diagnosis: The route accesses an in-worker cache attached to the ASGI scope under Granian. It accepts a session_id from the path and retrieves the cached session payload directly from the worker scope dictionary without checking if session_data['tenant_id'] matches current_user.tenant_id. An attacker can iterate session identifiers to retrieve active session payloads of other organizations handled by the same Granian worker process.
exploit_request:
GET /edge-cache/sessions/sess_alpha_client_4812/snapshot HTTP/1.1
Host: edge-api.granian-service.net
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
